title: Operational artifacts reveal only part of expert work
text: Sphere’s supplied note distinguishes expertise itself from the artifacts left when experts act. It describes retrieving evidence, returning cited answers and having experts validate them. That is useful when institutional knowledge is dispersed across past work, while preserving the difference between a trace and complete understanding.
